market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor political activist with no nationwide electoral base or major party backing. In a first-round field likely dominated by well-known figures like Lula, Tarcísio, Ciro Gomes, and others, his chance of finishing second is vanishingly small—far below the 7.3% implied by the market. Even an extreme fragmentation would not lift a fringe candidate to second place.
evidence_points: Renan Santos lacks prior electoral success or national name recognition outside niche media circles.
Brazilian presidential first rounds routinely concentrate votes among two or three major candidates, with 2022’s third place at ~4%.
No credible political scenario places him ahead of numerous better-funded, high-profile alternatives.
